runbook_steps.operator_meaning: Automated preflight checks for the content bundle and local configuration constraints.
runbook_steps.what_human_can_do: Inspect all active gates, bundle properties, and dry run results.
runbook_steps.what_system_cannot_do: Modify live server states or communicate with platform APIs.

runbook_steps.operator_meaning: Generates manual export bundles for the pilot deployment.
runbook_steps.what_human_can_do: Generate offline export packages for manual substack setup and download manual verification payloads.
runbook_steps.what_system_cannot_do: Write keys, env files, or invoke platform publishing engines.

runbook_steps.operator_meaning: Tracks which manual pilot export items are under operator inspection.
runbook_steps.what_human_can_do: Inspect queue states, view reviewable files, and log offline progress.
runbook_steps.what_system_cannot_do: Automate approvals, trigger webhook dispatches, or modify database states.

runbook_steps.operator_meaning: Reconciles operator review records with manual publish evidence inputs.
runbook_steps.what_human_can_do: Submit placeholder evidence and preview off-system manual publish records.
runbook_steps.what_system_cannot_do: Mutate real publish states or communicate with provider credential endpoints.

runbook_steps.operator_meaning: Forensic audit ledger verifying safety compliance flags across the entire manual trail chain.
runbook_steps.what_human_can_do: Inspect invariant check results, check contradiction flags, and read local evidence files.
runbook_steps.what_system_cannot_do: Perform live publishing, credential checks, or publish/approve operations.
